data.standardized_narrative: The PDF pages provided are scans of the 2018 Syndicate 2987 annual report denominated in US dollars. I could not confidently locate a clear, unambiguous GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding) or a definitive prior-year opening gross claims outstanding amount in the legible Balance Sheet images. A claims development table (claims development / triangle) appears to be present in the report, but the scanned quality and orientation prevented reliable numeric extraction; therefore no gross prior-year strengthening/release figure has been reported here. Gross written premium for 2018 is visible and reported below. Data extraction is incomplete and key reserve movement figures are null for safety.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as scanned images. Key reserve figures (gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 and the GROSS movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding) could not be confidently read on the Balance Sheet or the movement note from the images supplied. A claims development table appears present (pages ~39-40) but the scan quality and rotation prevented reliable numeric extraction for the triangle. Gross premiums and a segmental split (Brit Global Specialty Direct / Reinsurance) were legible and extracted. Where gross PYD or opening gross reserves could not be found with confidence, fields are null. If higher-quality PDF/text or crop of the Balance Sheet and Note on movement in provision is provided, I can extract the precise gross reserve and prior-year movement amounts.
